title: Water Questions
description: Use this service request to submit a general request or concern related to Water. Please call 214-651-1441 Monday-Friday from 8:00am to 5:00pm for routine Water calls such as making a payment, service discontinuance, theft of water, or water quality concerns. For Water emergencies such as a main break, burst pipes, leaks doing property damage or sewer issues please call 3-1-1 or 214-670-3111. The estimated response time for this service request is 2 business days.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for a general Dallas Water Utilities question or concern.
actions.why: Use the 311 request form for a general water-related request or concern. It asks for the Dallas Water Utilities account number, a service address if different from the account address, and the nature of the concern.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Water Questions" requests is not for routine water calls or water emergencies. If you have a routine question about making a payment, discontinuing service, water theft, or water quality, then call Dallas Water Utilities at 214-651-1441 Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. If there is a water main break, burst pipe, leak causing property damage, or sewer issue, then call 311 by phone instead of submitting a 311 request online.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Water Inquiries and Line Locates" > Choose "Water Questions"
